target_audience_note: "The easyPROTECT Discover service is a package of guarantees for insured persons whose main residence is in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, who are aged between 15-27 years and who are preparing to begin their professional life (students, apprentices and similar categories)." The insured persons are further described as "students or similar categories". The civil liability cover is expressly for "damage caused during private and student life excluding professional activities".
summary: Insurance product information document (IPID) for the easyPROTECT - Discover service distributed under the LALUX Assurances brand. The service is a package of guarantees for insured persons whose main residence is in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, aged between 15 and 27 years and preparing to begin their professional life (students, apprentices and similar categories). The basic package comprises civil liability for private and student life excluding professional activities — with a "Student accommodation" extension for tenants of student housing located in Europe — and legal protection. Mobile IT coverage, Assistance (tuition and apprenticeship fees, return costs, recovery of lost computer data) and Medical emergency (outpatient treatment, dental care, hospitalisation abroad and repatriation) are available as options for an additional premium, each subject to a stated monetary cap.

definitions.definition: Students or similar categories (with regard to Civil Liability cover, the related Legal Protection and “Student accommodation” extension, Mobile IT, Assistance and Medical Emergency). The "What type of insurance is it ?" section adds that they are persons whose main residence is in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, aged between 15-27 years and preparing to begin their professional life (students, apprentices and similar categories).

gaps: Risk carrier undeterminable. The document prints only the brand — "LALUX Assurances - Product : easyPROTECT - Discover" in the header band and the lalux logo — and refers to the insurer as "the Company" and "the insurance company". No legal form, no R.C.S. number, no registered address appears on either page; verified on a 4x render of both pages. lalux operates two authorised entities (LA LUXEMBOURGEOISE S.A., non-life, B 31035 and LA LUXEMBOURGEOISE-VIE S.A., life, B 31036) and naming neither does not allow one to be chosen. `insurer_name` carries the slug supplied in the task metadata and is not a reading of the document.

Branch divergence between the task metadata and the document, recorded rather than resolved. The metadata supplied `multirisque-professionnelle` and has been copied through as instructed, but the document describes a package for students and apprentices aged 15-27 whose civil liability cover is expressly for "damage caused during private and student life excluding professional activities". Nothing in the document is professional multi-risk cover. A reviewer may wish to retag this document; the allowed slugs for Luxembourg include `rc-familiale`, `protection-juridique` and `autres`.

`edition_date` is null: no edition date, version code, year or footer appears on either page. Verified on renders of both pages, whose lower margins are blank. Nothing has been promoted from the file name.

`is_optional` is stated by this document rather than inferred, which is unusual in this library. The heading "Basic package:" governs Civil liability (with its “Student accommodation” extension) and Legal protection, recorded as `is_optional: false`; the heading "As an option and for an additional premium:" governs Mobile IT coverage, Assistance and Medical emergency, recorded as `is_optional: true`. Both headings are confirmed on the render of page 1.

The “Student accommodation” extension is printed as an indented sub-item of the Civil liability bullet, without its own tick marker, and both the restrictions box and the territorial scope section label it "Civil liability - Extension “Student accommodation”". It has been recorded as a coverage in its own right so that its EUR 3,000 theft sub-limit and its European scope are not lost, while its dependence on the Civil liability cover is stated in its name and description.

The "Are there any restrictions on cover ?" section of this document contains genuine restrictions (four monetary caps), which have been recorded in the `limits` and `sub_limits` fields of the coverages they name rather than duplicated as exclusions. The ten entries in `exclusions` come from the "What is not insured ?" box (eight), from the civil liability description's own carve-out for professional activities (one) and from the territorial carve-out of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the United Kingdom under Medical emergency (one).

The only indexed figure is the Mobile IT limit, printed "EUR 284 (index 100)". The document does not identify the index, its base date or its revision mechanism, so the current cash value of that limit cannot be derived from this document; the figure is recorded verbatim.

No deductible, no waiting period and no franchise is mentioned anywhere; `deductibles` is null and `waiting_periods` is empty. The document carries a single contractual definition (the insured persons) and refers all other terms to the general and/or special conditions of the easyPROTECT product.

`prescription_period` has been filled from the "When does the cover start and end ?" section, which states that claims made after the end of the contract are covered only within three years of the occurrence of the damage. The document does not use the word prescription and states no other limitation period; the divergence between the section heading and the field is noted here rather than resolved.

Minor typographic inconsistency, not repaired: eight of the nine section headings carry a thin space (U+2009) before their question mark or colon, but "What are my obligations?" does not, and "Disclaimer:" does not either.

The prompt text was not truncated. It was checked character for character against a local re-extraction of the source PDF (data/lu/pdfs/lalux/multirisque-professionnelle/6893kb-23087ad2.pdf, sha256 65bcc07a3bc8…) using the same page.get_text("text") call as the harness: both pages match exactly.

Character traps respected in the quotes: nine thin spaces (U+2009) before "?" and ":" in the headings, curly double quotes (U+201C/U+201D) around “Student accommodation”, one U+2019 apostrophe and U+2022 bullets isolated on their own lines. Structured fields carry the rendered form, quotes carry the text layer verbatim. All quotes were sliced programmatically as exact spans of the cited page and none crosses a [[page N]] marker.

Branche corrigee en amont le 2026-08-03 (etait multirisque-professionnelle): le document est un produit etudiants et apprentis de 15 a 27 ans, excluant les activites professionnelles; son socle est une responsabilite civile privee avec extension logement etudiant et protection juridique. Rien n'y est du multirisque professionnel.
